attributes.powers: For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d10+2. If the bane has the Demon, Devil, Fiend, or Undead trait, add another 2d6. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. If you fail this check, you may put this card on top of your deck to reroll the dice; take the new result.
